Forcing people's identities to be determined by their birth. As if the child of a capitalist will always be a capitalist? The child of the poor will always be poor? Ha! Then you will forever remain that ignorant fool too.  
No one chooses to be trapped in a body that contradicts their true gender. You just happen to have your real gender match what you call "biological sex." If the two didn't align for you as well, you would be supporting transgender rights too.  
Being trans is not a choice, not a political stance—it is a condition! It describes the objective reality of gender incongruence. Just like even if you scream "Asians don't exist," they still exist. Transgender people objectively exist, and your denial is utterly useless—it only lets your pathetic brain briefly revel in a delusion of pleasure through self-deception.
